sync off, lane off => pr lane: legacy sync off, lane off
sync plan, lane off => pr lane: legacy sync plan, lane off
sync apply, lane off => pr lane: legacy sync apply, lane off
sync off, lane plan => pr lane: legacy sync off, lane plan
sync off, lane apply => pr lane: legacy sync off, lane apply
nothing set => pr lane: legacy sync off, lane off
invalid lane mode => pr lane: legacy sync off, lane off
no configuration => pr lane: legacy sync unknown, lane unknown (configuration unavailable)
